event: Atlético Dallas signed Javier 'Chicharito' Hernández on a two-year deal with a club option for a third season, making him the club's first-ever player ahead of their 2027 USL Championship debut.
Atlético Dallas will play home matches at the Cotton Bowl (capacity 92,100) when it begins USL Championship play in March 2027.
Flint City Bucks defeated Ventura County Fusion 1–0 in the USL League Two National Semifinal on Oliver Moller-Jensen's late winner, advancing to their seventh League Two Final.
Ventura County Fusion were eliminated from the 2026 USL League Two Playoffs 0–1 by Flint City Bucks in the National Semifinal.
Vermont Green FC demolished Laredo Heat SC 7–1 on the road in the USL League Two National Semifinal, with Ryan Zellefrow completing a hat trick, to reach their second consecutive League Two Final.
Laredo Heat SC were eliminated from the 2026 USL League Two Playoffs 1–7 by Vermont Green FC in the National Semifinal.
New York Renegades defeated Detroit City FC II 3–1 in the UPSL East Region Final at Krenzler Field, Cleveland, advancing to the UPSL National Finals on August 7–9.
Detroit City FC II were eliminated from the 2026 UPSL Spring Playoffs 1–3 by New York Renegades in the East Region Final.
Deportivo Rose City defeated Next Level Soccer 2–1 in the UPSL West Region Final at Cardinale Stadium in Seaside, CA, advancing to the UPSL National Finals.
Next Level Soccer were eliminated from the 2026 UPSL Spring Playoffs 1–2 by Deportivo Rose City in the West Region Final.
Miami United FC advanced over SCU Heat via 6–5 penalty shootout after a 1–1 draw in the UPSL South Region Final, booking their place in the UPSL National Finals.
SCU Heat were eliminated from the 2026 UPSL Spring Playoffs via penalty shootout (5–6) against Miami United FC in the South Region Final after weather delays.
Central Kansas United advanced from the UPSL Central Region to the National Finals, where they will face Deportivo Rose City in the semifinals on August 7.
Flint City Bucks will host Vermont Green FC in the 2026 USL League Two Final on August 1 at Atwood Stadium, aiming for a record fifth league title.
Vermont Green FC travel to Flint for the USL League Two Final on August 1, seeking to become the first back-to-back League Two champion since 2003.
